title: Certify actual P104 Newton producer and consumer interfaces
body:
## Why this is needed

[PR #3382](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3382) proved a Gaussian Newton entrance for one literal P104 collector. It left three concrete implications open: whether the actual preceding producer supplies that entrance, whether the actual downstream consumer preserves the representation and requested map, and whether a complete implementation can improve the bill.

This focused package, `research/p104-newton-interfaces`, answers those assigned questions on the actual source paths. It follows the [claim in Discussion #2750](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19008790), pins canonical main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, and retains PR #3382's model/proof at `2834523b1cd4ea83ba7a043e2e2f5f3332cf9909` byte for byte. Task `p104-side-correction` has scope **changed** by the user’s explicit assignment to these three PR #3382 questions; the original card and decision are retained in `TASK.json`. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## New results

### 1. Actual producer admission, with a reachable counterexample

The real precollector dependency cone has **257 events, 58 initial banks, 200 native transports of total rank 354, and 52 quarter ADDs**. All six dirty D/Q entrances are supplied in `B9` when the 52 named initial Y banks are in `4B9` and the initial D/Q banks are in `B9`. The stronger Y condition is necessary and sufficient for the stated prefix invariant; it does not classify extra final-cut admissions caused by cancellation.

The weaker initial `B9` contract fails on **`Y27[0]=64`**, with every other initial component zero. All 358 initial banks lie in `B9`, and the actual full prefix through event 2024 remains arithmetically exact. The first membership failure in the entire 2,025-event prefix occurs at **event 1090**. At the collector entrance, `D31[8]-D31[0]=-1`, violating degree-one Newton divisibility. Separate valuation and full-prefix numerical implementations agree; amplitude 256 is the positive control.

### 2. Actual downstream restoration and explicit representation maps

The bounded open program has **63 persistent banks, 576 internal events and all 675 outgoing ADD ports**, through event 4516. The producer cone is already included. Its initial contract is the 52 Y banks in `4B9` plus 11 arbitrary dirty D/Q/G banks in `B9`. External recipient histories are not executed by this projection.

A phase-sensitive certificate authenticates **392 native occurrences across 163 frames**, including **230 redundant path equalities**. It checks all 18 Pauli-generator images and an exact nonzero anchor, rejecting a changed global return phase that Pauli images alone cannot detect.

Writing `A_H` for the authenticated empty-to-frame operator, every persistent bank ends as **`A_F` applied to its initial value**, and private `C` is literally zero before erasure. The actual full-frame operator and its coefficient intertwiner are

$$
A_F=(C^{-1})^{\otimes9},\qquad
E^{-1}A_FE=\begin{pmatrix}1&i\\0&-i\end{pmatrix}^{\otimes9}.
$$

The complete outgoing interface includes **348 Y→D, 171 Y→Q, 104 G→X and 52 initial-Q7→X** reads. After normalising each X increment by its own source-frame operator, the 52-by-52 bank-coefficient matrix has rank one: each target receives a signed half-sum of the 52 initial Y banks, with 39 positive and 13 negative signs and cancellation of dirty D/Q/G coefficients. This is a **frame-normalised port operator**; a final physical X endpoint needs its omitted updates and transports.

The actual Q/F coefficient maps are reconstructed column by column. Their logical contract is `E^-1 A E`; an exact counterexample distinguishes it from applying `A` directly to arbitrary coefficients. Persistent compatible representations need no intermediate codec pairs, while exposed adapters and the 52 stronger Y admissions remain charged obligations.

### 3. Complete logical bill and conditional stopping decision

The independently reconstructed direct schedule includes **148,736 floor pairs, 784 actual wrappers, 425,230 Gaussian scratch swaps and 857 ADDs**. It costs **2,067,456 real add/subtract operations plus 159,744 doublings**, with **594,944 native floor halves and 1,382,400 exact quarter halves**. Component traffic, setup, storage and cleanup are retained. Conservative bounds from initial component height `H` are **1568H** for internal payload, **7840H** for pair work and **1600H** per outgoing increment; current recipient widths remain separate.

Physical admission, ownership, routing, control, adapters and recursive completion remain explicit unknown charges. Under exactly the inherited width-73, five-forward/four-dual profiles and coverage law,

$$
M_B(a)\ge1+\frac{1560}{73(832+B)}>1
$$

for `0<=a<1` and every finite number of fully paid auxiliary banks. At `B=0`, this is the credited **599/584** stop. It excludes expansion with that unchanged consumer, not arbitrary changed P104 profiles or coverage laws. This PR claims no complete supplier or improved κ.

## Verification

The package combines written proofs, exhaustive finite operator certificates, dense signed fixtures and separately written source/count, full-prefix and scalar-row checks. Reproduction commands:

```sh
python3 -B research/p104-newton-interfaces/verify.py
python3 -B -O research/p104-newton-interfaces/verify.py
```

**Local verification passed on CPython 3.12.14.** Registered normal and optimised complete replays produce the same retained receipt, SHA256 `fbc444897b13be5973c92ecfa5de67a8efae13b1aca0d8181bd430e2cffba1d3`. A Git-free optimised replay also passes with Git unavailable. The public commit is `15d28c4de37dc47ea07cd7173c8b318fca7a4d75`, tree `194bec3ab755726b686f4b9ba83f0d0835130c13`, byte-identical to the tested tree. All 28 package/source files pass `check_research_commit.py --check-source-history`; the checked public export has those same 28 byte-identical inputs. The hosted [Registered research packages run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39086204821) also passed both the plan and package replay jobs for this public head. These are automated checks and cross-review, not external human or formal proof-kernel review.

## Open next questions

The package README and `TASK.json` retain two concrete handoffs: join all 675 ports to the actual external target histories and widths, or present a changed caller/profile with paid admission and a complete favourable cost screen. The first needs actual recipient continuation; the second needs a changed premise and full physical/recursive charges. The unchanged-profile supplier effort stops here.

## Concurrent work and credit

The presubmission sweep covered 323 open PRs and 192 visible Discussion records, with incomplete Discussion pagination. It found Nick Petalas's complementary [PR #3406](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3406), head `18a054fd585ab4b2010770ec83cba0c9f28184e3`. That package classifies the whole-word independent-product entrance under inherited native covariance and explicitly links this active local-interface claim. Its broader theorem is credited pending context; it is not rerun or claimed as this package's result.

Clear1nsight, with substantial OpenAI assistance, including concurrent mathematical and implementation review agents. Credit remains with ywz65/PR #2586, Arham Tahir/PR #2665, Tekalign/PR #3025, Ross Richardson/PR #3068 and PR #3382. The inherited stopping insight is Jose Manuel's [Discussion finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2619#discussioncomment-18955566), source-audited by Vasek in [PR #2744](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2744). Apache-2.0; predecessor notices and exact sources are retained.

## Post-publication overlap and credit update

The live handoff on 2026-10-18 found Nick Petalas's [PR #3416](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3416), published after our presubmission snapshot. At exact head `f1112560883a5e81b1a29c37c81a79a20be31fe3`, it reports a separate exhaustive certificate of all 1,245 archived native chart identities and all 2,070 occurrences, supplying PR #3406's inherited covariance premise. Its metadata and written proof were inspected; its suite was not rerun here. Our independently written 392-occurrence path certificate serves the bounded producer/consumer join and does not claim that broader canonical-chart audit. The Pauli-plus-anchor equality criterion is established predecessor mathematics, with explicit credit to Tekalign's [PR #3218](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3218) and the original Clifford/native lineage.

Nick's [separate correlated final-cut investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19009365) has since produced [PR #3426](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3426), exact head `ce2221dddab6efd3027c09269765dd7eb45f2877`, explicitly following this PR's distinction between a prefix invariant and final-cut cancellation. That follow-up reports an ideal correlated entrance and a reachable literal cancellation; its metadata was inspected, and its suite was not rerun here. This context update changes only the PR description; the tested scientific commit, receipt and source ZIP remain fixed.

## Portable source export

The attached ZIP contains all 28 committed package/source files and the export integrity manifest. Its SHA256 is `d2b9d67f4b2f73aa10e5f141b8f5fa64ba93ad95bf2605addb219650bd2b02af`. Extract it and run the direct commands above from its root.
